excerpts.content:
I would change how https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/_features/eip8025/proof-engine.md is defined here:
- Remove the proof creation side, and replace it with a simple POST api in the beacon node. 

Allows ZK teams to manage their own timing, and when the proof is ready just submit it to the beacon node.

https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/660
